entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I... I need to make a return. I just feel so bad about it, I've had it for a little while.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the item?

It's a jersey I bought. It's just the wrong size. I tried it on and it's way too tight. I was so excited for it, and I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years... I really feel awful asking, but I really need the money back.

I'm sorry to hear the fit wasn't right. It's important that your gear is comfortable. It sounds like you might be interested in an exchange for a different size, or just a straight return. Is that correct?
Yes, either would be... but I'm worried it's been too long. I ordered it over a month ago.
Let's take a look. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see your order from 38 days ago for the Aero-Pro jersey. Not a problem at all. For a standard apparel item like this jersey, you are well within our 90-day return window.
Oh, really? It's okay? That's such a relief. I was so worried.
Absolutely. Since the jersey is the wrong size because it's too tight, we can definitely process a return for a full refund or an exchange for a larger size. Which would you prefer?
A full refund would be amazing, thank you so much! You've really helped me out.

You're very welcome. I have just initiated that return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid shipping label to the email we have on file. Just package the item, attach the label, and you can drop it off at your local post office. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive it.
That's perfect. Thank you again, Diana. You've been wonderful.
It's my pleasure. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
